items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday (second straight). Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist) on IR/return. If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR order: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore.
items.why: Missed two practices post-Week 1 aggravation; Lane already IR
items.implication: Lamar/Andrews targets concentrate; Bateman flex upside

items.text: Nico Collins suffered a hamstring injury in Wednesday practice (Grade 1 strain per reports); DNP Thursday after limited Wed. History of missing 5 games on hammy in 2024. Ran 37 of 42 routes Week 1. MRI/status key; jeopardy for Week 2 vs CIN.
items.why: Practice injury + soft-tissue history; doctors say not serious but availability jeopardy
items.implication: Bench/ contingency plan; WR routes open for depth
items.opportunity: Xavier Hutchinson 29 routes, Kayshon Boutte 27, Jaylin Noel, Dalton Schultz bump if OUT

items.text: Joe Burrow limited second straight day (back tightness/injury); expects to play Sunday at HOU. More active Thursday than Wednesday.
items.why: Back tightness post-Week 1; player says normal soreness, will play
items.implication: Monitor Friday; Flacco backup if worsens; Chase/Higgins still viable

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full practice participant, says 'ready to go' for Week 2 home opener vs PIT after missing Week 1.
items.why: Full practices + player confirmation via Mike Reiss
items.implication: Split with Stevenson; explosive element returns for NE offense (AJ Brown IR)
items.opportunity: Henderson flex/ upside carries; Stevenson volume dip possible

items.text: Ladd McConkey (rib) working off to side with trainer Thursday after DNP Wednesday; day-to-day post-Week 1 hit. ETR waiver: McConkey absence elevates Tre' Harris.
items.why: Rib injury from big hit; limited progress midweek
items.implication: Herbert targets to Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris/TE if limited/OUT
items.opportunity: Tre' Harris primary waiver beneficiary per ETR

items.text: Chris Olave (hamstring) added as limited Thursday (not on Wed report); possible practice issue after big W1 (10-182). Monitor Friday.
items.implication: Potential sit risk vs BAL; Vele/others elevate if OUT

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in KC debut; 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q. RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy.
items.why: Workhorse usage + targets in new offense; Indy matchup soft vs run
items.opportunity: 29/32 early opps + routes/targets per Levitan corroboration

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) full participant Wednesday/Thursday; HC Kellen Moore expects him to play Week 2 vs BAL after missing Week 1. ETR listed Miller as beneficiary of Kamara absence.
items.why: Full practices + coach confirmation; faster recovery than initial MCL timeline
items.implication: Etienne role compresses (W1 9 carries/7 catches split); reverse Miller stash
items.opportunity: Kamara eats snaps/targets; Etienne still viable but less volume

items.text: ETR W2 Waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller (now reverse); plus Deebo waiver priority.
items.why: Precise injury-linked adds with FAAB/stream notes
items.implication: Prioritize Bateman/Harris/Deebo/Doubs; reverse Miller if Kamara plays

items.text: Devonta Smith on LOVE list Week 2 despite tough Week 1; bounce-back expected.
items.why: Tough W1 but back in; usage/matchup trust

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: career-high 26% tgt share + more routes than Gainwell + both RB RZ touches. Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% share from Wentz; strong history vs CHI.
Ashton Jeanty LOVE/upgrade: Utilization Score 99 in first game under Kubiak (only Bijan higher). Overreaction to injury scare.
items.why: Elite util score signals featured role
items.implication: Start with confidence; RB upside locked

items.text: Colston Loveland 89% routes (highest TE W1) despite 0 pts/2 tgts — buy low if seller panics (missed EZ throw). Dalton Kincaid 69% routes/77% snaps (career highs recent) — healthy breakout signal.
items.why: Elite route shares signal opportunity; efficiency/health context
items.implication: Hold/buy Loveland; elevate Kincaid TE1 range
items.opportunity: High snap/route rates over raw fantasy pts

items.text: Kenyon Sadiq (16th pick) sneaky optimistic debut: 28 snaps despite missing OTAs/camp mostly (hernia). Schemed goal-line carry + screen + 2 other targets. Clear intent to involve.
items.implication: Stash TE/RB hybrid upside; goal-line role
